criteria.text: Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.

Identifies that the Ingleby Systems Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Flags the inconsistency between the SPA and employment agreement non-compete periods.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
